newsitem.title: MONACO: TENNIS-RIOS TAKES REVENGE OVER COSTA IN MONTE CARLO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RIOS TAKES REVENGE OVER COSTA IN MONTE CARLO.

text.p: Marcelo Rios took sweet revenge over Albert Costa at the Monte Carlo tennis Open on Thursday with a straight-set victory over the Spaniard who prevented him from reaching last year's final.
Playing almost to perfection, the 21-year-old Chilean seventh seed won 7-6 6-4 in a match which should be a big morale booster for him as the clay court season gears up.
In the quarter-finals, Rios, who lost to Costa in the semifinal last year, will meet Sweden's Magnus Larsson, who ousted American world number one Pete Sampras in the previous round.
Larsson eased past Czech Daniel Vacek 7-5 6-0.

"I was born on clay, I like to play on clay but when you play as well as I did today, the surface doesn't matter," said Rios, who has had a lacklustre season so far, reaching only one ATP Tour final, in Marseille in February.
"Of course I remembered last year's semifinal here and I knew what I had to do," he added.
What he did was serve systematically to Costa's forehand to prevent him for using his punishing backhand.
The tactics paid dividends from the middle of the first set, when Rios broke back at 4-4 and cruised through the tie-break 7-3.
He then broke early in the second set and kept the upper hand until the end even though Costa, winner on Monday in Barcelona, saved two match points.
In Larsson, Rios will meet a player he has met twice this season, with a win and a loss.
"But I beat him the last time we played on clay", he said.
